evidence.observed: Official page states current prices are valid for AdHoc charging and the fahr-e LadeApp on DEW21-operated infrastructure: AC 0.54 EUR/kWh, DC 0.64 EUR/kWh, incl. VAT. Blocking fee 0.03 EUR/min, triggered 30 minutes after charging ends; AC only in the published daytime window, DC continuously; exemptions include lantern charging points and certain paid-parking locations. External roaming in fahr-e ended 2026-07-31, so the current scope is DEW21-operated points.

cpos.conclusion: Complete at the operator tariff-policy level because the primary operator explicitly states that the numeric grid applies to AdHoc charging on DEW21-operated infrastructure. Preserve published blocking-fee exceptions and do not infer an eMI3 prefix.

evidence.observed: Official current page documents public charging in Osnabrück, OPG parking facilities and ladenetz access, but does not expose a current numeric contract-free direct-payment tariff matrix for the Stadtwerke-operated public EVSEs.

Official page promotes the OPG E-LadeCard with billing by direct debit or credit card and no blocking fee for that product; this is a card/product channel and is not treated as proof of the ad-hoc price at every EVSE.
Current station listing confirms ad-hoc direct payment is possible at the Stadtwerke site but reports the ad-hoc price as unknown.

cpos.conclusion: Partial/deferred. Public direct charging exists, but no exact current primary station/EVSE tariff authority was verified. Keep fail-closed until a QR checkout payload, current official ad-hoc price sheet, or other primary station-level price is available.

evidence.observed: Current August 2026 discovery source reports TankE ad-hoc values of 0.49 EUR/kWh AC and 0.59 EUR/kWh DC with time-based blocking rules. This is retained only as a discovery lead because a matching current primary RheinEnergie/TankE tariff authority was not verified in this pass.
Current RheinEnergie station-level listing shows 0.49 EUR/kWh AC and separate DC/blocking values, but it is not primary operator evidence and therefore is not generalized network-wide.

cpos.conclusion: Partial/deferred. Multiple current discovery sources support a TankE/RheinEnergie ad-hoc price pattern, but no primary operator or checkout authority was verified in this pass. Do not promote the sampled/discovery tariff as a network fallback.

notes: DEW21 is complete only because the primary operator explicitly binds the current numeric grid to AdHoc charging on its own infrastructure.
Osnabrück card/product conditions are not used as ad-hoc tariff evidence.
RheinEnergie/TankE third-party 2026 values remain discovery-only pending primary authority.
